subject.title: Feature: Talk Mode Idle Timeout / Auto-Deactivation After Voice Wake

question: What public Talk idle-timeout contract should OpenClaw support for deactivating inactive Talk sessions after Voice Wake starts them?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds public lifecycle/config behavior and could affect all Talk sessions, so automation should not choose the durable product contract alone.

options.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
options.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

options.title: Scope to Voice Wake-started sessions only
options.body: Track the activation source and auto-deactivate only sessions started from Voice Wake, leaving manually started Talk sessions unchanged.

options.title: Defer to broader voice lifecycle work
options.body: Keep the issue open but wait for a larger Talk/Voice Wake lifecycle design that also covers realtime sessions and mobile behavior.

recommendation.title: Approve additive Talk idle timeout
recommendation.body: Add a canonical Talk config field with explicit units, limits, disabled behavior, and reset events, then wire it through config, protocol, docs, and macOS runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across Talk config/runtime and repository product/config policy in the inspected evidence.
